# Speekify

> Speekify is an open-source local text-to-speech CLI powered by Supertonic v3. It converts inline text, piped stdin, local text files, text-based PDFs, readable web articles, and YouTube transcripts into WAV audio generated on the user's machine.

## Canonical pages

- English website: https://otterlyspacelabs.github.io/speekify/
- French website: https://otterlyspacelabs.github.io/speekify/fr/
- Source code and README: https://github.com/OtterlySpaceLabs/speekify

## Product facts

- Category: open-source command-line text-to-speech software
- Synthesis engine: Supertonic v3
- Output: local WAV file
- Inputs: inline text, stdin, .txt, .md, text-based PDF, readable URL, YouTube transcript
- Privacy: synthesis runs locally; generated audio is not uploaded to a remote speech service
- Languages: automatic source-language detection plus many Supertonic language codes
- Voices: ten built-in voices (M1-M5 and F1-F5) plus custom Voice Builder JSON styles
- AI integration: built-in MCP server for compatible assistants
- License: MIT
- Installation: Homebrew on macOS, pipx or uv from PyPI, or from source with uv
